name: Bravado
body:
You are rash in combat, refusing to back down from your enemies’ blows.

Prerequisite: None

Effect: You don’t gain any benefits from any kind of dodge bonus to your Armour Class. Spells, items and effects that provide a dodge bonus provide no benefit to you. You cannot use the withdraw action in combat.
